_meta.description: Frozen IAST(romanized key) -> IPA segment map for the 34 consonant varṇas of lexicon_wordformation.json.
_meta.conjunct_rule: kṣa (ksha) is the cluster /k͡ʂ/; its feature vector is the elementwise MEAN of the k and ʂ vectors (frozen).
_meta.inherent_vowel_note: The inherent /a/ is NOT included in the feature vector; features describe the consonant segment only (pre-reg §11 carrier-vowel invariance handles the constant /a/).
_meta.scheme: Sanskrit phonology; retroflex ṭ-varga apical, dental t-varga laminal, palatal c-varga as palato-alveolar affricates, śa=ʃ ṣa=ʂ sa=s ha=ɦ.
